title: Safety, tolerability, and efficacy of alixorexton, a selective orexin 2 receptor agonist for narcolepsy type 1 (Vibrance-1): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial
title_zh: 安全性、耐受性与疗效：阿利克索雷克斯（Alixorexton）——一种选择性鞍突2受体激动剂用于1型发作性睡病（Vibrance-1）随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、2期试验
abstract: BACKGROUND: The clinical potential of orexin 2 receptor (OX2R) agonism for improving measures of wakefulness and cataplexy in patients with narcolepsy type 1 has been described in a phase 2 study. Here, we aimed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and efficacy of alixorexton, another oral OX2R agonist, in narcolepsy type 1. METHODS: In this randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial, adult participants (aged 18-70 years) with narcolepsy type 1 were recruited from 46 hospitals and private research centres across the USA, Europe, and Australia. Participants were centrally randomly assigned (1:1:1:1) in blocks of four via an interactive response technology system stratified by region and baseline weekly cataplexy rate (WCR) to receive 4 mg, 6 mg, or 8 mg tablets of alixorexton or placebo once daily for 6 weeks, followed by an optional 7-week open-label extension. Participants had narcolepsy type 1, diagnosed per the International Classification of Sleep Disorders, Third Edition, and confirmed by overnight polysomnography and the Multiple Sleep Latency Test or cerebrospinal hypocretin-1 concentrations. The sponsor, assessors, investigators, and participants were masked during the randomised double-blind treatment period. Efficacy and safety assessments were conducted in participants who received at least one dose of study drug. The primary endpoint was change from baseline to week 6 in mean sleep latency (MSL) on the Maintenance of Wakefulness Test (MWT). Safety endpoints included treatment-emergent adverse events. This trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06358950) and is completed. FINDINGS: Between May 24, 2024, and May 5, 2025, 153 individuals were screened and 92 participants were randomly assigned to receive alixorexton 4 mg (n=23), 6 mg (n=22), 8 mg (n=24), or placebo (n=23). Mean age was 33·5 years (SD 12·1), 57 (62%) were women, and 35 (38%) were men. At week 6, the observed MSL on the MWT was 2·3 min (SD 2·7) for placebo, 24·0 min (8·7) for alixorexton 4 mg, 25·9 min (9·4) for 6 mg, and 28·2 min (11·4) for 8 mg. Alixorexton improved MSL on the MWT, with a least-squares mean placebo-corrected change from baseline of 22·2 min (95% CI 17·2-27·2) for alixorexton 4 mg, 24·1 min (19·0-29·1) for 6 mg, and 26·0 min (21·0-31·0) for 8 mg (adjusted p=0·0099 for 4 mg, adjusted p<0·0001 for 6 mg and 8 mg). Treatment-emergent adverse events occurring in at least 5% of participants given alixorexton and more frequently than those given placebo up to week 6 were pollakiuria (38 [55%]), insomnia (19 [28%]), salivary hypersecretion (17 [25%]), micturition urgency (ten [14%]), blurred vision (ten [14%]), and hyperhidrosis (five [7%]). INTERPRETATION: In this phase 2 trial, once-daily oral alixorexton provided clinically meaningful improvements at 6 weeks for participants with narcolepsy type 1, including in wakefulness, excessive daytime sleepiness, and cataplexy. The treatment was generally well tolerated, with adverse events consistent with the known on-target effects of OX2R agonists. Together, these findings support the further phase 3 evaluation of alixorexton as a potential therapeutic option for people with narcolepsy type 1. FUNDING: Alkermes.
abstract_zh: 背景：在一项2期研究中，已描述鞍突2受体（OX2R）激动剂在改善1型发作性睡病患者清醒度和突发性瘫痪（cataplexy）方面的临床潜力。本研究旨在评估另一种口服OX2R激动剂阿利克索雷克斯（alixorexton）在1型发作性睡病中的安全性、耐受性和疗效。方法：本随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、2期试验招募了18-70岁、符合国际睡眠障碍分类第三版诊断标准并通过夜间多导睡眠监测和多睡眠潜伏期测试或脑脊液下丘脑素-1浓度确认的1型发作性睡病成人，共46家医院和私人研究中心（美国、欧洲、澳大利亚）。受试者通过交互式响应技术系统按地区和基线每周突发性瘫痪率（WCR）分层，以1:1:1:1的比例分配到四个组：每日一次口服4 mg、6 mg、8 mg阿利克索雷克斯或安慰剂，持续6周，随后可选择性进行7周开放标签延伸。随机双盲治疗期间，赞助商、评估者、研究者和受试者均保持盲法。安全性和疗效评估仅对至少服用一次研究药物的受试者进行。主要终点为第6周相较基线的平均睡眠潜伏期（MSL）在维持清醒测试（MWT）中的变化。安全终点包括治疗相关不良事件。本试验已在ClinicalTrials.gov注册（NCT06358950），并已完成。结果：2024年5月24日至2025年5月5日，共筛查153人，随机分配92人接受阿利克索雷克斯4 mg（n=23）、6 mg（n=22）、8 mg（n=24）或安慰剂（n=23）。平均年龄33.5岁（SD 12.1），女性57人（62%），男性35人（38%）。第6周，MWT中的观察到的MSL为安慰剂组2.3分钟（SD 2.7），阿利克索雷克斯4 mg组24.0分钟（8.7），6 mg组25.9分钟（9.4），8 mg组28.2分钟（11.4）。阿利克索雷克斯显著改善MWT中的MSL，四个剂量组相对安慰剂的最小二乘均值基线校正变化分别为22.2分钟（95% CI 17.2-27.2）4 mg、24.1分钟（19.0-29.1）6 mg、26.0分钟（21.0-31.0）8 mg（调整后p=0.0099 4 mg，p<0.0001 6 mg和8 mg）。在第6周前，至少5%受试者出现且比安慰剂组更频繁的治疗相关不良事件包括多尿（38人，55%）、失眠（19人，28%）、唾液分泌过多（17人，25%）、排尿急迫（10人，14%）、视力模糊（10人，14%）和多汗症（5人，7%）。结论：在本2期试验中，每日一次口服阿利克索雷克斯在6周内为1型发作性睡病患者提供了临床意义的改善，包括清醒度、过度日间嗜睡和突发性瘫痪。治疗总体耐受性良好，不良事件与OX2R激动剂已知的靶向效应一致。上述发现支持进一步开展3期评估，以评估阿利克索雷克斯作为1型发作性睡病潜在治疗方案的可行性。资助：Alkermes。
